gate_definition: Define spoilboard fixture datum centerline registration and clamp keepout zones.
evidence_required: Fixture sketch or reviewed setup sheet plus photo after setup.
stop_condition: No CNC setup or slot path release.

gate_definition: Define cutter type bit width kerf compensation and acceptable edge condition.
evidence_required: Tool record plus same-material kerf coupon measurement.
stop_condition: No slit width or radius can be taken from CAD alone.

gate_definition: Define stock flatness thickness moisture grain/orientation and defect checks.
evidence_required: Shop stock record and pre-cut inspection note.
stop_condition: No tuning or stiffness assumption can be used.

gate_definition: Define same-material coupon cuts for slot width end radius tearout and cleanup.
evidence_required: Coupon ID photos measured result and pass/fail note.
stop_condition: No full top or shell cut.

gate_definition: Define first-article path dry run or sacrificial cut before the real panel.
evidence_required: First-article record with deviations and adjustment note.
stop_condition: No production body or tuned tongue cut.

gate_definition: Define how CAM file fixture setup and tuning log share a revision ID.
evidence_required: Revision entry in validation loop and packet README.
